description: Na₄PtPdH₈ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight H atoms. There are four shorter (2.53 Å) and four longer (2.54 Å) Na-H bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight H atoms. There are six shorter (2.53 Å) and two longer (2.54 Å) Na-H bond lengths. Pt is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four equivalent H atoms. All Pt-H bond lengths are 1.66 Å. Pd is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four equivalent H atoms. All Pd-H bond lengths are 1.65 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded to four Na and one Pd atom to form a mixture of corner, edge, and face-sharing HNa₄Pd square pyramids. In the second H site, H is bonded to four Na and one Pt atom to form HNa₄Pt square pyramids that share corners with thirteen HNa₄Pd square pyramids, edges with six HNa₄Pd square pyramids, and faces with two equivalent HNa₄Pt square pyramids.
